Tragic train accident in Bangkok

Dashcam footage shows the moment a train collided with a bus in Bangkok on Saturday. At least eight people were killed and 25 others injured in the crash, which triggered a fire that engulfed the bus.

VIDEO: REUTERS https://t.co/arSHtPvxmV
